summary.text: David Haley is a Democratic member of the Kansas Senate representing District 4, and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2001.

paragraphs.text: According to the same page, David Haley served in the House (1995–2000) before the current service in the Senate that began in 2001.
David Haley is listed as a member of the Financial Institutions and Insurance Committee and the Judiciary Committee.
The Legislature lists David Haley's occupation as Public Affairs Council.
